# Support & Community Help

Thank you for using **VN-MURL SafeWeb**! Here are the recommended ways to get help and find answers:

---

## 📚 Documentation
- **[System Architecture (ARCHITECTURE.md)](../ARCHITECTURE.md)**: Comprehensive deep dive into the 4-layer system topology, ML pipeline, lexical extractor, and security models.
- **[Project README](../README.md)**: Quickstart guides, Docker instructions, API references, and credentials.
- **[Implementation Decisions](../docs/IMPLEMENTATION_DECISIONS.md)**: Rationales behind architectural choices, thresholds, and data strategies.
- **[Colab Research Notebooks & Metrics](../research/)**: Authentic academic research outputs, 19 CSV metrics, and 40 visualization figures.

## 💬 Community Channels
- **GitHub Discussions**: Post questions, share feature ideas, or discuss research methodologies at [VN-MURL SafeWeb Discussions](https://github.com/NguyenTriBaoThang/VN-MURL-Safeweb/discussions).
- **Issue Tracker**:
  - Found a bug? Open a [Bug Report](https://github.com/NguyenTriBaoThang/VN-MURL-Safeweb/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml).
  - Need a new feature? Submit a [Feature Request](https://github.com/NguyenTriBaoThang/VN-MURL-Safeweb/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml).
  - Model classification feedback? File an [ML Feedback Report](https://github.com/NguyenTriBaoThang/VN-MURL-Safeweb/issues/new?template=false_positive_report.yml).
